signal: Most AI tutors wait for the child to ask the right question, but children often do not know what to ask.
Parents often know that their child studied for two hours, but they do not know whether the child actually understood anything.
Eddy should guide students like a patient tutor, not behave like a dashboard.
Learning requires effort, mistakes, correction, and repetition. Friction is not always bad.
A lot of EdTech focuses on smoother content delivery, but not enough on helping students build agency.
